name: Generated Type Parity Enforcement
description: CI must fail if generated TypeScript types do not match current schemas.
purpose: Types and schemas must never diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: CI pipeline includes a step that regenerates TypeScript types from schemas
CI step compares regenerated types against committed types and fails on mismatch
Diff output shows exactly which types diverged and how
Documented workflow for developers to regenerate types locally
Type generation script runs deterministically (same input → same output)
Failure message includes instructions to regenerate and re-commit
